experiments.name: Local application acceptance
experiments.scope: Actual PDF processing, PostgreSQL, staff review, current-balance approval and the browser UI. Latest full regression run.
experiments.limitation: Functional tests on fictional inputs, not accuracy on representative unseen invoices. Axe scanned the login and mobile workspace; it does not certify every accessibility requirement.

experiments.name: Authored edge-case validation
experiments.scope: 25 author-known synthetic scenarios, four PDF representations each. Separate from application integration tests.
experiments.limitation: Controlled layouts and explicit product codes. The author also wrote the implementation; no independent human label audit or unseen-invoice accuracy guarantee.

experiments.name: MiniLM retrieval diagnostic
experiments.scope: 36 simple descriptions against 80 fictional catalog items. Original experiment used GPU; local application uses the pinned ONNX model on CPU.
experiments.limitation: Previously inspected categories, matchable queries only. These results do not establish calibrated confidence or approval safety.

experiments.name: Harder matching experiment
experiments.scope: 720 fictional product-description pairs. Fine-tuned checkpoint evaluated at a score-ranked 90% pair automation budget.
experiments.limitation: A separate development experiment; that trained cross-encoder is not the live approval policy. Pair coverage is not invoice automation.
